name: Post-Alpha 0.60H - Hosted Clawd Persistence Foundation

productFrame.atlas: Map/chat app with an instant voxel view of the local world, session notes, local context, and elevated neighborhood understanding.
productFrame.clawdbot: Paid Hosted Clawd service that can later manage local business and neighborhood work from owned Atlas state.
productFrame.whyPersistenceNow: Clawdbot cannot become a paid local operator until account ownership, business context, Scout Drops, and campaign drafts are durable and owner-protected.

storage.migrationStrategy: committed SQL migrations plus a small Node runner

auth.model: OAuth/OIDC account linking for protected Hosted Clawd writes

firstPersistenceSlice.savedPath: create or attach owned Hosted Clawd, save business profile, save Scout Drop summary, save campaign preview draft
firstPersistenceSlice.ownerBoundary: Every write derives owner_user_id from verified OIDC subject. Session ids never resolve as persisted Clawds.
firstPersistenceSlice.idempotency: owner_user_id + operation + client_request_id returns the original saved records
requiredTests: valid bearer token verifies subject, email, and scopes
User A cannot read or write User B's rows
session Clawd id cannot load persisted Clawd
seven public Alpha tools remain stable

blocked: checkout route that creates a live session
